_comment: Everything that changes from one season to the next. refresh.py embeds this in the page as DATA.cfg; engine.js reads circuits and field size from it. Update it before the first race of a new season.

defaultTeam._comment: The example team a new browser starts with (driver TLAs, constructor team names).

teams._comment: F1 Fantasy team name -> short code, livery colour and the Jolpica constructorIds that map to it.

circuits._comment: Meeting-name fragment -> [power (straight-line emphasis), street (walls, low grip), fast corners (aero)], 0-1, and a note. Claude's classification; the effects are fitted in engine.js trackModel().
